top_signals.title: European Natural Gas Prices Plunge 8% as U.S.-Iran Tensions Ease
top_signals.summary: European natural gas prices plunged by 8.6% at the open in Amsterdam on Monday as the United States paused strikes on Iran over the weekend and Tehran signaled a halt to retaliatory attacks across the Middle East. Hopes of de-escalation sank oil prices on Monday in Asian trade, too, with Brent Crude dropping to $90 per barrel. Europe’s benchmark natural gas prices, which had surged in the past two weeks amid the renewed hostilities, retreated on Monday from the multi-month highs of last week, as the market hopes for a diplomatic push to reopen…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AT&T Kick Starts Sale of Five-Part Euro, Sterling Bond Deal
top_signals.summary: AT&T Inc. has opened books on a at least €2 billion ($2.23 billion) euro and sterling bond offering, injecting a large corporate deal into what’s a traditionally subdued period for Europe’s primary market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
